---
title: Code block style, per-side stroke
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

A template sets a per-side `stroke` in `quarto-code-block-style`: a 3pt blue top rule and no other side.

```{=typst}
#quarto-code-block-style.update(s => s + (stroke: (top: 3pt + blue, rest: none)))
#show block: it => {
  let s = it.stroke
  if type(s) == dictionary and s.at("top", default: none) != none and s.top.paint == blue {
    assert.eq(s.top.thickness, 3pt, message: "top rule thickness")
    assert.eq(s.at("left", default: none), none, message: "left side must have no stroke")
    counter("cbs-top").step()
  }
  it
}
```

```python
x = 1
```

```{=typst}
#context assert.eq(counter("cbs-top").final().first(), 1, message: "expected 1 code block with a blue top rule")
```
